integrity: The verifier reconstructs the complex from the published group generators and five facet representatives, then checks integral boundary identities, unimodular minors, an explicit cocycle, all four-vertex supports, and symmetry orbits using only the Python standard library.
limitations: Exact for the published ten-vertex Bagchi--Datta triangulation. The result classifies only minimum four-vertex integral \(H_2\)-supports; it makes no claim about larger supports or other triangulations. An unindexed finite computation could still duplicate the census.
title: The diagonal sphere is the unique nonprimitive shortest \(H_2\)-cycle in the natural ten-vertex \(\mathbb{CP}^{2}\)
